The Team

The Team

Looking for the best tour operator in Kerala? Look no further. Captivating India is a destination management company based in the historic port city of Kochi with pan‑India operations. Our team consists of seasoned travel professionals who manage our head office in Cochin.

Our offices are manned by local staff who are well trained and are aware of their responsibility to the community and environment. Wherever possible we work with small concerns and individuals so that most of your holiday cost is dispersed directly into the community.

We involve local communities wherever possible, as their involvement – however small it may be – leaves a lasting impression of the places you visit and the experiences you have. All of us are well travelled and regularly visit the places that we promote to ensure that standards remain consistently high.

Our own and associate offices throughout the country, along with excellent relationships with hotels and transport partners, ensure consistently high standards of holiday at competitive prices.

Contact us for arranging a holiday or for just friendly advice – we are here to help. Our aim is to offer the discerning traveller an outstanding holiday experience. For more details or for an obligation‑free quote, contact info@captivatingindia.co.uk.
